author: Legoche
body:
This is a series I started on my channel in which I 1v1 Avicus players on Badlion/Kohi.

This week's episode was ColdCraftMC. If you want to 1v1 me, add my skype (downfallgaming123) and message me with your IGN, and ask for available times.

Anyways, here is the video. I hope you enjoy! Please remember to like, comment and subscribe!

Video: http://youtu.be/rby8FUOaI6M

As usual, quality/video may be bad for 10-20 mins after post.
